title: The Paymaster's Box
summary: The Company's paymaster kept the robed strangers' coin in the Tithe Mill, in two boxes, because he trusted nobody, including himself. Brannoc wants to see whose seal is on it.

steps.journal: Open two chests in the Tithe Mill.

ready: Talk to Brannoc (tap his card, then Talk).
done: Coal-red wax on every purse, and no crest in it. Brannoc kept one seal. He turns it over when nobody looks.
